title: Register portable capability tests without silently omitting sources
problem: Discovering test source files with a wildcard can silently omit a declared test when its file is missing.
example: A registration naming test/conformance/test_output.cpp is a required Make prerequisite; deleting that source fails the build rather than shrinking the test suite.
design: Each capability adds a small explicit registration. A shared Make fragment provides compiler, reference-library, C++ standard and optional-extension handling.
tradeoffs: Registrations are additional build metadata, but independent feature branches add separate files and do not edit one combined test source or suite list.
